description: This file defines the EntityCondition class used for constructing and validating query conditions in Drupal's JSON:API module, including handling of filter parameters and allowed operators.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents a filter condition for EntityQuery, including validation and creation from query parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new EntityCondition with specified field, value, and operator.

methods.name: field
methods.description: Returns the field to be evaluated.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in the condition.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the value for the condition.

methods.name: createFromQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition object from a query parameter array.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the filter parameter array for required keys and allowed operators.
